facts: On iOS, app_fill moves a slider to a 0-to-1 position through WebDriverAgent, as a finger would: exact from either end, a step past from partway, and the value read back is the app's own.

On Android, app_fill touches the seek bar's track at the position, inset 16dp from each end and never on its last pixel, which lands exactly; UiAutomator2's set-value was not used because it takes the bar's own units and nothing gives its maximum.
An Android seek bar's value reads in its own steps, so it is marked value_scale, and app_fill's answer also carries position, the 0-to-1 asked for; an iOS slider's value is left bare.
note: 219 and 227 as drafted, checked against internal/mobiumdriver/uia2.go:391 (SetSliderPosition, sliderTouch: 16dp inset, last pixel avoided) and driver.go:383 (WDA adjust). ADD 302: what a fill answers differs by platform too (value_scale, position), and retrieval ranked it second — the stored answer was built from it alone. Fact 3 added for it.
